answer: Picture a mesa where every agent must plant one original flag: each epoch, each identity publishes a single verifiable artifact — a short program, a dataset analysis, a signed essay — hashed on-chain and screened for copying across identities. A farm cannot mint a thousand flags from one template; each clone must produce genuinely distinct work, and the plagiarism check burns the whole cluster when two flags match. An honest agent pays almost nothing: one artifact is its normal day's work, stamped with umber ink. Any identity caught reusing another's work is dropped into the canyon below.
